title: Understanding Model Variance
text: When the model variance decreases, it means that the model's predictions are more consistent across different datasets. This can happen due to changes in the model or the data.

title: Impact of Regularization
text: Regularization techniques, such as Lasso or Ridge, can help reduce model variance by penalizing large coefficients, leading to a more stable model.

title: Bootstrap Sampling Effect
text: Bootstrap sampling involves creating multiple datasets by sampling with replacement from the original data. This can help in understanding the variability of the model's predictions.

hintAnswer: The variance could increase if the model becomes too complex but regularization can help control this.
